newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian shares end touch easier but off day's lows.
newsitem.headline: Italian shares end touch easier but off day's lows.

text.p: 1532 GMT - Italian stocks ended slightly easier but off the day's lows after a quiet pre-weekend session as the market paused for breath after soaring earlier in the week. Dealers said the downturn was normal but that sentiment remained positive and expectations were for a robust start on Monday.
* All-share Mibtel index down 0.14 percent at 13,388
* Mib30 blue chip index off 0.15 percent at 20,353

* Prices lifted off lows by rallies in late trading by Fiat, up 0.42 percent at 6,171 lire, and insurance stocks led by Generali ahead of its AGM on Saturday which put on 2.32 percent to 31,337 lire. But INA lost against the trend, depressed by a profit warning for 1997, ending down 2.77 percent at 2,628 lire.
* Banks were mixed, with Ambroveneto up 5.84 percent to 5,109 lire as operators saw its proposed merger with savings bank Cariplo getting closer. But BCI and Credito Italiano eased.
* ENI, on final day of its third tranche share offer, saw an official closing price of 9,575 lire.
